updater_diagnostic.old_parser: Strip HTML tags, find a date, scan the next 260 characters, then take the first five strictly increasing tokens in 1..40.
updater_diagnostic.root_cause: Systemic parser weakness: date and numbers were associated by proximity in flattened page text rather than by the result cell in the same contest row. The exact fragment that produced the 2026-11-11 row cannot be reconstructed because the scheduled updater did not persist the raw response. This is a demonstrated design defect, not proof that this specific row is false.
updater_diagnostic.additional_issue: The old URL loop stopped after any non-empty parsed page, even if that page contained only older draws; it could therefore skip a later fallback source containing a new draw.

q60.reason: The official archive page does not yet publish the 315 combination; the existing paired freezes remain pending.

quantitative_hypothesis.statement: A parser that binds a date and exactly five valid sorted numbers to cells in the same table row will reject incomplete contest rows and unrelated numbers elsewhere in the page.
quantitative_hypothesis.acceptance_rule: The first cell must contain one supported Italian date; the second cell must contain exactly five distinct ascending integers in 1..40; no look-ahead outside the row is permitted.
quantitative_hypothesis.test_plan: Eight deterministic unit tests: valid row; pending row with nearby unrelated numbers; script numbers outside the row; six-token result cell; invalid ordering/range/duplicates; stale first source does not short-circuit fallback; conflicting sources fail closed; conflicting duplicate date fails closed.
quantitative_hypothesis.reason: The newly appended 315 row has unresolved official-source provenance. Running a new predictive walk-forward or scoring the next target on this archive would risk training on an unverified outcome.

limits: The raw HTML response fetched by the scheduled updater was not persisted, so the exact source fragment that produced the 2026-11-11 row cannot be reconstructed.
The official Sisal latest-draw page confirms contest 315 and its prize profile, but the five numbers are not exposed in the retrieved text.
The official VinciCasa November archive still shows contest 315 as in programmazione; two secondary sources agree on the five numbers, but this is not sufficient for canonical Q60 scoring.
This audit is a data-pipeline test, not a predictive validation and has no Discovery/Validation/Blind OOS split.
The existing main archive and generated app JSON are not rewritten by this research PR; the row remains flagged for human review.
